summary: Residential kerb where cars park; garages face it, houses 23-26 m back.

best_section.where: North kerb opposite the grassy front yards, in front of the garage blocks at the west end

drivers.seclusion: Garages (non-dwelling) face this section at 11-13 m; nearest houses 23-26 m; apartments 12 m from 41 m onwards.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both sides; room to stop beside them.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars park on both kerbs, so a van would blend in.

flags: Dwellings within about 25 m on this side
Low-lying: about 5-6 m elevation, no mapped waterway
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sun; street trees shade the middle of the kerb from the north in the morning.
